items.title: GTA 6 Is Selling Out PS5 Consoles, but Sony's Black Friday Plans Make It Even Worse
items.summary: PS5 consoles have sold out at major US retailers less than a week after GTA 6 launched, and Sony has no Black Friday discounts planned.

items.title: Attempts To Vibe-Code PC Ports Of GTA 6 Are Being Shut Down, But It Might Be Too Late To Put The Genie Back In The Bottle
items.summary: Take-Two's takedown request led GitHub to remove all 3,007 Project Leonida repositories, while other AI-assisted PC port attempts continue.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Reportedly Frying Some PS5 Consoles
items.summary: Streamers and Reddit users report crashes and even smoking PS5s while playing GTA 6.

items.title: GTA 6 Has a Creepy Pennywise Easter Egg That You Shouldn't Miss
items.summary: Players found a midnight-only IT the Clown encounter in the Haymarket Hotel elevator in Vice Beach.

items.title: Your Jason And Lucia Might Be Clones In GTA 6
items.summary: A walkthrough of The Final Flush mission reveals a hidden sewage-plant facility and a dark bunker Easter egg behind code 3612.

items.title: GTA 6 Players Find a New Mission That Lets You Fight the Devil, Here's How It's Unlocked
items.summary: A secret Chapter 2 mission in Port Gellhorn sends players to Hell to fight Satan, with rewards including a shotgun and a permanent health boost.

items.title: GTA 6 update gives players losing progress to crashes a lifeline
items.summary: Patch 01.002.002 fixes crashes, autosaves, weather, phone calls and Wanted Level bugs, and leaves the first-person and 60fps glitches alone.

items.title: GTA 6 Runs Better On Xbox Series X Than Base PS5
items.summary: Digital Foundry testing found the Series X holds the 30fps target more consistently than the base PS5, which has more frame drops into the 20s in crowded areas, while the PS5 Pro is the best-performing console overall.

items.title: GTA 6's Most Spectacular Easter Egg So Far Has Just Been Discovered
items.summary: A long puzzle chain across 12 substations unlocks a portal to the 2002 Vice City and gives Tommy Vercetti's shirt and bike.

items.title: GTA 6 "hit Call of Duty HARD," analyst reports, with a 42% drop in daily players
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates Call of Duty's daily active users fell 42%, from 7.5 million to 4.4 million, after GTA 6 launched.
